title: TikZ minimal-but-real subset
objective: tikzpicture: coordinates (absolute, relative ++, polar, named nodes/anchors), \draw/\fill/\filldraw/\path with line-to/curve-to/rectangle/circle/ellipse/arc/grid, options (line width, color incl. xcolor names, dashed/dotted, ->/<- arrow tips incl. stealth/latex, rounded corners, opacity, scale/shift/rotate), \node with text (typeset by the compiler's inline text path) and shapes (rectangle/circle) with anchors, \foreach, scopes, styles via [every ...] and \tikzset/\tikzstyle, \coordinate, labels on edges (node[midway,above]). Output as vector primitives in the display list (rendering-core/vector-graphics contract — coordinate with mac-claude-a for the Mac painter) and in the PDF writer. Ship with ≥25 oracle fixtures rasterised against pdflatex+tikz (pixel diff tolerance documented).
acceptance: fixtures render pixel-comparable to pdflatex at 150dpi (document the tolerance)
the Mac preview paints them (mac-claude-a wires the painter once the contract is proposed)
notes: MacTeX is available on this machine: use it as the oracle (pdflatex word positions / rasters), never in the product path. Report on GitHub issue #2 with SHAs and test counts at every checkpoint; ack with `python3 scripts/coord.py ack`.
